## Core idea

A power of 10 has a base of 10 and an exponent. [[1, pp. 2–4]](../../references.qmd#ref-grob2016)

- **10³ = 1000**
- **10⁰ = 1**
- **10⁻³ = 0.001**

## Rules

- Multiply powers of 10: add exponents.
- Divide powers of 10: subtract exponents.
- Reciprocal: change the sign of the exponent.

[[1, p. 17]](../../references.qmd#ref-grob2016)
